label: D2: reached S2 (esp. via rare a1->S2) after an unrewarded previous trial, late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when S2 is shown (0 activations at D1/GO or with S1 shown); D2&S2 alone has recall 1.0 but precision 0.05. Within that, it is strongly gated by the previous trial being unrewarded (96% of mass has prev_reward==0) and by the transition being rare a1->S2 (75% of mass; a2->S2 common gives weaker activations). The largest activations are rare a1->S2 after a run of unrewarded a1 choices, which comes with low model value (all mass at value < 7.7; strongest at value < 7.1). Activation rate rises steadily across the episode (trials 80-99 give about 57% of mass; near zero before trial 10), so there is a slow within-episode drift that the predicate does not capture. Recorded predicate D2 & S2 & prev_reward==0 & action==1 uses only variables observed at D2 (dev F1 0.49, mass recall 0.71). Adding value < 7.13 instead of action gives mass recall 0.82 at F1 0.44. Precision stays limited because many matching steps early in the episode or at high value do not fire.
